definitions.explanation: The pupil of the eye — the black, adjustable opening at the center of the iris that lets light in. A medical and anatomical term.

examples.japanese: {瞳孔|どうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{瞳孔|どうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you shine a bright light, the pupils contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{瞳孔|どうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧、⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor examined the patient's pupil response to check their state of consciousness.

notes:
The anatomical term for the eye's pupil. In everyday speech the pupil and surrounding dark iris are usually called ⟦{瞳|ひとみ}→瞳：02252_hitomi⟧ or {黒目|くろめ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞳孔|どうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: the pupils dilate
- {瞳孔|どうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収縮|しゅうしゅく}→収縮：11889_shuushuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the pupils contract
- {瞳孔|どうこう}⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: pupillary reaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{瞳|ひとみ}→瞳：02252_hitomi⟧: pupil; eyes — poetic/everyday word, often for beautiful eyes
- {黒目|くろめ}: the dark part of the eye — casual term covering the iris and pupil
